description: This file defines the DbSessionFactory class, which acts as a wrapper around Hibernate's SessionFactory for OpenMRS modules supporting versions up to 1.12. It provides methods to obtain current database sessions and access to the underlying Hibernate SessionFactory.

classes.name: DbSessionFactory
classes.description: A wrapper class for Hibernate's SessionFactory, tailored for OpenMRS modules to support various versions up to 1.12.

methods.name: DbSessionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DbSessionFactory with a Hibernate SessionFactory.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description: Returns a new DbSession object representing the current database session.

methods.name: getHibernateSessionFactory
methods.description: Returns the underlying Hibernate SessionFactory object.
